cq_coverage.details: All competency questions are answerable with the current ontology structure. Each CQ is supported by appropriate classes, properties, and restrictions; no CQs remain unaddressed.

strengths: Rich and deep class hierarchy reflecting EDIFACT structure
Good use of cardinality and existential restrictions
Comprehensive property characteristics and disjointness axioms
weaknesses: No use of GCAs or equivalence axioms for necessary/sufficient conditions
Disjointness could be extended further among technical classes
Technical vocabulary for EDIFACT segment/element codes and D96A mappings is not expanded

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4: Minor risk of missing domain/range in some technical properties, but major relations are covered
P7: Inverse properties are mostly present, but completeness should be checked for new relations

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) and equivalence axioms, e.g., define Buyer as an Organization with AgentRole 'BY' and InvoiceParticipation in an InvoiceMessage.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Enable necessary/sufficient reasoning and richer query support

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add more disjointness axioms among core EDIFACT technical classes (e.g., Message, Section, Segment, LineItem) to prevent modeling errors.
Expand technical vocabulary for EDIFACT segment/element codes and mappings (e.g., explicit BGM/NAD code values, D96A mappings).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better alignment with EDIFACT and automated parsing/validation

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add usage examples and rdfs:seeAlso links to external standards (EN 16931-1, P2P-O) for key classes.

summary: The ontology remains robust, with full coverage of all competency questions and correct use of OWL 2 constructs. However, none of the high or medium priority suggestions from the previous review were implemented. The ontology would benefit from general class axioms, equivalence class definitions, and expanded technical vocabulary for richer reasoning and better EDIFACT alignment.

suggestions_ignored: Introduce General Class Axioms (GCAs) and equivalence axioms
Add more disjointness axioms among core technical classes
Expand technical vocabulary for segment/element codes and D96A mappings
Add usage examples and rdfs:seeAlso links
improvement_tracking.notes: No new improvements were made since the last review. While coverage and quality remain stable and high, the absence of advanced axiomatization and technical enrichment limits further progress.
